## RefreshOutcome.status property

- `updated` — content changed and was rewritten (file was pristine or `--force`<!-- -->). - `unchanged` — already matched the current render; nothing written. - `recreated` — file was missing and was written from the render. - `conflict` — on-disk content diverged from the recorded hash; left untouched (no `--force`<!-- -->). - `overwritten` — diverged but rewritten because `--force` was set.

**Signature:**

```typescript
status: 'updated' | 'unchanged' | 'recreated' | 'conflict' | 'overwritten';
```
